name: Mei Lian Tan
bio:
Mei Lian's passion for motorsport ignited during her polytechnic years, where she excelled in materials engineering. After graduating, she secured an apprenticeship with a local racing team, honing her skills in composite fabrication and repair. Her dedication and attention to detail quickly made her an invaluable asset, leading to a full-time position. 

At MP Motorsport, Mei Lian is known for her meticulous approach to composite work. She believes in constant learning and experimentation, always seeking new techniques to improve the strength and aerodynamics of the race car components. She is particularly adept at carbon fiber layup and vacuum bagging, ensuring each part meets the highest standards of quality and performance. Mei Lian's creative problem-solving skills and commitment to innovation set her apart, making her a highly valued member of the team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair usually tied back in a high ponytail.
physical.description: Mei Lian has a lean athletic build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with sketches and ideas.
Has a habit of tapping her fingers on surfaces when deep in thought.
Insists on cleaning her workspace meticulously before and after each task.
